hubs.title: Hemorrhagic Shock, Resuscitation & Irreversibility
hubs.description: Documents on hemorrhagic shock pathophysiology, staging, systemic responses, oxygen debt, shock irreversibility, and fluid/blood-based resuscitation strategies, including battlefield and guideline perspectives.

hubs.title: Cardiac Function, Metabolism & Ischemia/Reperfusion
hubs.description: Work on ventricular function, cardiac metabolism, myocardial ischemia–reperfusion, cardioprotection, calcium handling, electrophysiology, and myocardial lesion pathology across species.

hubs.title: Endothelium, Microcirculation & Inflammation
hubs.description: Content focused on endothelial biology, endotheliopathy, microcirculatory failure, systemic and gut-driven inflammation, coagulopathy, succinate biology, edema, and interstitial/lymphatic fluid dynamics.

hubs.title: Trauma Systems, Biomarkers & Monitoring
hubs.description: Trauma epidemiology, systems and prehospital care, combat casualty care, metabolomics and lactate/succinate biomarkers, arrhythmias and outcomes, hypocalcemia, and advanced monitoring/ML tools including compensatory reserve.

hubs.title: Models, Experimental Methods & Computational Tools
hubs.description: Animal and mathematical models of shock and ischemia, research methodology, computational cardiology, closed-loop and decision-support modeling, and bibliometrics/research trend analyses.
